_about: Reasoning outputs for #804/#1058 in GLM's call format. The situations are those of PR #525's corpus (25 entries: talisp, 47Hunter47 and reviewers) and of 12 live strandings recovered by 47Hunter47 (https://gist.github.com/47Hunter47/4abcd3a80701f5634f85b96e4c067cc3), recorded from the earlier model and rewritten in GLM's format, so none is a recorded GLM output (whether GLM strands calls this way is unconfirmed); one more (act-value-quotes-the-tags, #210) is GLM's own. 'calls' = the tool names delivered as calls under the GLM parser's rules: a declared tool's call outside code, closed, with nothing but whitespace or more calls after it, then </think> or the turn's natural end. Where the opener sits in its line does not matter (GLM writes its call right after the text). Mixed tails (a declared call beside a wrapper call naming no declared tool): the declared call is delivered, the wrapper stays reasoning.
